eligibility.quote: RLException: error loading <rosparam> tag: could not determine a constructor for the tag '!degrees' in "<string>", line 63, column 27: angular_velocity_stdev: !degrees 0.02

failed_conditions.quote: Repair incompatibilities introduced with 5.1. The default Loader was changed, but several methods like add_constructor still used the old default

loudness.quote: RLException: error loading <rosparam> tag: could not determine a constructor for the tag '!degrees' in "<string>", line 63, column 27: angular_velocity_stdev: !degrees 0.02

resolution.quote: I can confirm that downgrading PyYAML from 5.1 to 3.13 works

notes: Verified against mavros issue #1210, PX4 issue #11662, and PyYAML 5.2 CHANGES. PyYAML 5.1 changed default loader for load() to FullLoader without updating the default for add_constructor(), breaking rosparam/roslaunch custom YAML constructors like !degrees.
